short_summary: HealthRate, Inc. (HealthRate.io) is a Nevada‑incorporated, Hudson, WI‑based SaaS company that helps payers and related stakeholders obtain the best pricing for high‑cost healthcare claims through an award‑winning AI‑enabled platform offered on a monthly subscription model; it has a production product, $9M+ pipeline ARR, 87% gross margin, $15,000 monthly marketing burn, and has raised $1M pre‑seed via a convertible promissory note from First Trust Capital Partners.
long_summary:
HealthRate, Inc., operating under the brand HealthRate.io (website www.healthrate.io), is a Nevada corporation headquartered in Hudson, WI. The company provides an AI‑enabled SaaS platform that addresses price irrationality and extreme pricing volatility in high‑cost healthcare claims by delivering the best pricing for payers, at‑risk providers, employers, stop‑loss providers, reinsurers, and other third‑party service providers. The solution leverages decades of domain experience, trillions of data points, advanced statistical methods, and recent AI/ML advancements to offer real‑time, unbiased pricing recommendations via a monthly subscription model priced by the number of lives supported.

The product is in production, with a reported $9M+ pipeline ARR and an 87% gross margin. Financial projections show revenue milestones ranging from $0 to $9,276,000, and a monthly marketing burn rate of $15,000. The company’s capital structure includes 17,500,000 authorized shares, 10,587,500 issued and outstanding, and 6,912,500 reserved for an equity incentive plan. HealthRate has raised $1M in a pre‑seed round through a Convertible Promissory Note issued to First Trust Capital Partners, with the note bearing an 18% annual interest rate and maturing on August 30, 2026. The target raise amount in the note purchase agreement is $1,000,000, and proceeds are earmarked for closing the pipeline and expanding sales (40%), scaling the platform and compliance features (30%), expanding data ingestion and actuarial modeling (15%), and operations and customer success (15%).

Key competitive advantages include proprietary algorithms, a patent‑pending HealthRate Institutional Index (utility‑provisional patent application #63/707,441, Patent Center #67575019), and a unique data‑driven approach that normalizes costs across providers. Regulatory exposure stems from a Cornell/SCOTUS ruling that creates ERISA fiduciary obligations for plan pricing, while risk disclosures note potential legal challenges for employers overpaying for healthcare services under new transparency regulations. The market opportunity is outlined as a $500M‑$1.8B total addressable market.

Key personnel include CEO Tim Michaels, Chairman James A. Bowen, Chief Technology Officer Jeff Sage, EVP of Sales & Market Development Tom Sherrard, Chief Commercial Officer Nikki Ahlgren, and advisory board members Paul Stordard, Geoff Bartsh, Robert Van Why, and Mark Nathan. Additional notable figures mentioned are Jonathan Phillips (role unspecified) and Bob Van Why (advisory board). The company’s stage is pre‑seed, with no disclosed valuation, runway, cash on hand, or detailed user metrics. The dossier reflects a strong strategic positioning in the healthcare SaaS sector but highlights several data gaps (e.g., MRR, growth rate, LTV, CAC) that remain unreported.
